0525573844.desc: Ingenious magic system based on industrial programming — a thief discovers her city is built on ancient, dangerous technology called scriving.

1449373321.desc: Data is at the center of many challenges in system design today. Difficult issues like scalability, consistency, reliability, efficiency, and maintainability need to be figured out. In this practical guide, author Martin Kleppmann helps you navigate this diverse and fast-paced landscape by examining the pros and cons of various technologies for processing and storing data.

0593723848.desc: The political intrigue deepens as the investigation uncovers corruption at the heart of the empire — even better than the first installment.

1984820680.desc: At most technology companies, you'll reach Senior Software Engineer, the so-called 'terminal level,' in about five years. Beyond that point, growth becomes nonlinear. Staff Engineer provides concrete advice for navigating the principal-track career path — from forging a path to staff, sharpening the skills required, and operating across organizational boundaries.

1984820710.desc: Outstanding mystery-fantasy hybrid with inventive worldbuilding — an investigator and her assistant solve murders in a city threatened by leviathans.
